title: Aisha midnight cluster jotter
content:
Quick brain dump for midnight shift (structured mess).

Context:
- Running hot on pool-ml-priority this week; 13B jobs spiking 99p latency at 3am window. Need short-term mitigations before autoscaler change.
- Not formal runbook, more personal checklist and things to follow up on.

Immediate priorities (start of shift):
- Check pool-ml-priority headroom: desired min=4, current min=2 (change in progress). If <30% spare GPUs, trigger scaleup plan.
  - kubectl get nodes -l pool=ml-priority -o wide
  - grafana dashboard: infra/gpu/pool-ml-priority -> check spare capacity panel (last 1h)
- Inspect 99p latency spike: correlate with batch size + cold cache. Look for pattern on model=llama-13b-q4_0.
  - dcgm exporter metrics: gpu_sm_efficiency, sm_active, mem_used, gpu_temp.
  - Search logs: /var/log/runtime/llama-13b/2025-11-03*  (grep "tail-latency").

Commands I ran (save for later):
- nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 10 6  # quick util sampling
- kubectl logs -n model-serving $(kubectl get pods -n model-serving -l app=llama13 -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') | tail -n 120
- curl -sS "https://internal-metrics.redwood/gpu/pool-ml-priority?range=1h" | jq '.[] | {t: .ts, util: .gpu_util}'

Short actionable todos (personal):
- [ ] Raise INF ticket for autoscaler min bump to 4 for pool-ml-priority (JIRA-INF-1287) — leave justification: nightly 3am spike and customer SLA risk.
- [ ] Add temporary routing rule to allow overflow to dedicated-fallback region if pool saturates (talk to Net: NET-4523).
- [ ] Post short note in #infra-ops summarizing 99p spike and actions taken (include grafana links + sample logs).
- [ ] Tag noisy pods for later: add label stress-test=true for pods that repeatedly OOM.
- [ ] Schedule node reboots for rack 4B: fans on node-412 showing slightly high temps; reboot 2025-11-06 02:00 UTC.

Operational heuristics / thresholds I care about:
- If GPU free < 10% for > 20m across pool -> scale policy = immediate scaleup (notify SRE).
- If <5% GPU free and queue latency > 250ms -> enable fallback to quantized variant.
- Alert if GPU temp > 83C on 2+ GPUs in same host -> escalate hardware ops.

Networking notes / outstanding:
- NET-4523: BGP flap last night around 02:45 PST impacted cross-rack traffic — follow up with Net on mitigation (announce timing + which leafs).
- Reminder: confirm patching window for spine switches before rolling reboots (avoid 01:30-03:30 PST).

Hardware / GPU ops notes:
- Node 412: fan#2 noisy, temp spike + one ECC error last week. Ticket HW-721 created but not scheduled. Add to rack reboot plan.
- Consider temporary MIG partition for inference-heavy workloads on 8xA100 hosts to reduce tail latency for small jobs. Quick try: set mig profile 1g.
- Check nvlink errors: show in /sys/class/infiniband/rdma_cm/statistics (or vendor hw mgmt).

Observability / followups:
- Add a tag in grafana panels to show quantized vs full-precision model variants (easy filter during incidents).
- Create an alert for 'cache-hit-rate < 40% for prefix cache' -> low cache hit correlates with tail latency.

Hand-off notes (end of shift):
- Leave short summary in /ops/handoffs/2025-11-04: what I saw, commands run, tickets created (INF-1287, NET-4523), owner for follow-up (Evan Malik).
- If autoscaler change is applied, monitor 3am window tomorrow; ping Priya if unexpected scale events.

Questions to follow up / unknowns:
- Why did only jobs for model=llama-13b spike? Is there a scheduled retrain or nightly batch hitting same prefix? Check ML training calendar.
- Is quantized variant (q4_0) registered and available in fallback routing? Might need model-catalog update.

Notes to self (quick):
- Avoid sweeping reboots during sales demos (ask calendar before rebooting prod racks).
- Keep sprint PRs small — merged runtime PR 2197 altered batching algorithm; might be contributing. Check PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2197

End-of-shift checklist:
- [ ] Ensure INF-1287 created + owner assigned
- [ ] Post incident note in #infra-ops
- [ ] Drop handoff file in ops/handoffs and notify on Slack
- [ ] Attach sample logs and grafana links to ticket

Random reminders (brain dump):
- Label cables on spare shelf S2 (B -> 4), last time half labeled, messy.
- Revisit quantization perf numbers for 13B: compare q4_0 vs q8_0 in latency/cost.
- If doing reroute to dedicated-fallback, ensure auth tokens are valid and no data-plane leaks.

If nothing else: go home, get sleep.

-- A.C.
